# `chat` — `/api/chat`

Chat router — personas, conversations, and chat turns: the streaming WebSocket (/ws) and a non-streaming /complete. Each turn's system prompt is budgeted to the model's real context window; central also gets native tools and the MCP tool loop, and destructive or publishing tool calls wait for approval.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/chat/agent-config`](#get-api-chat-agent-config) | Return notes, history window and the chat tool preference. |
| PUT | [`/api/chat/agent-config`](#put-api-chat-agent-config) | Persist notes, history and an explicitly supplied tool preference. |
| POST | [`/api/chat/complete`](#post-api-chat-complete) | Run one chat turn without streaming (the same turn the WebSocket runs) and return the whole reply, its conversation id and the run's evidence. |
| GET | [`/api/chat/conversations`](#get-api-chat-conversations) | Return the 50 most recently updated conversations. |
| DELETE | [`/api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}`](#delete-api-chat-conversations-conv-id) | Remove a conversation and all its messages. |
| GET | [`/api/chat/conversations/{conv_id}/messages`](#get-api-chat-conversations-conv-id-messages) | Return all messages for a conversation, oldest first. |
| GET | [`/api/chat/conversations/{conversation_id}/runs`](#get-api-chat-conversations-conversation-id-runs) | Every recorded run of a conversation, oldest first, each with its evidence and steps: what informed each reply. |
| GET | [`/api/chat/personas`](#get-api-chat-personas) | Persona picker data for the Chat UI: id, display name, role, default model. |
| POST | [`/api/chat/upload`](#post-api-chat-upload) | Extract text from an uploaded file and return it for chat injection. |
| WS | [`/api/chat/ws`](#ws-api-chat-ws) | Streaming chat. |

<a id="post-api-chat-complete"></a>
### `POST /api/chat/complete`

Run one chat turn without streaming (the same turn the WebSocket runs) and return the whole reply, its conversation id and the run's evidence. 502 when the turn fails.

- Handler: [`chat_complete`](../../../backend/routers/chat.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `ChatRequest`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | yes |  |  |
| `persona` | string | no | `"central"` |  |
| `model` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `server_host` | string | no | `"localhost"` |  |
| `server_port` | integer | no | `11434` |  |
| `conversation_id` | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `stream` | boolean | no | `true` |  |
| `server_id` | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `project_id` | integer or null | no |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `response`, `conversation_id`, `evidence`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | {sink.error} | `chat_complete` |

<a id="get-api-chat-personas"></a>
### `GET /api/chat/personas`

Persona picker data for the Chat UI: id, display name, role, default model.

Filters out non-persona entries in models.json (e.g. "sad-talker", a GPU-tool config block that lives in the same file but has no "name"/"llm" shape).

- Handler: [`list_personas`](../../../backend/routers/chat.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item JSON object with `id`, `name`, `role`, `model`
